title: After Salah – dhikr and dua
intro: Before we get up: salawat, Ayat al-Kursi, tasbih and a dua.

learn.html: When we finish the fard, we stay sitting for a moment and remember Allah – this is dhikr.

items.label: Then: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah…

learn.title: 📖 Ayat al-Kursi
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) taught us to recite Ayat al-Kursi after every fard prayer. Learn it: Ayat al-Kursi after Salah.
All four parts with the recording: Dhikr and Dua after Salah · Tasbih after Salah.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: After Salah we raise our hands and ask Allah for good for ourselves, our parents and all believers.

practice.title: Match the words and the meaning

questions.q: How many times do we say Subhaanallaah after Salah?
Which ayah do we recite after every fard prayer?
options: The last ayah of Al-Baqarah only

questions.q: What do we call remembering Allah?

practice.title: This week
prompts: 📿 After every prayer this week, do the tasbih – count on your fingers!
🤲 Make a dua for your parents after Salah.
